seatAcceptanceFee.locator: JoSAA 2026 Business Rules: Step 3 'Seat Acceptance Fee' (printed p.33-34), Clauses 56-58 (Section XXII, p.49-51)
seatAcceptanceFee.rule_text: Rs. 15,000 for candidates with the category tag SC, ST, GEN-PwD, GEN-EWS-PwD, OBC-NCL-PwD, SC-PwD or ST-PwD and Rs. 30,000 for all other candidates (the fee includes Rs. 5,000 JoSAA processing charges). Excluding Rs 5000 processing charges it is adjusted against admission fee. Fee must be paid only in the round in which the seat is allotted for the first time, or via optional pre-payment; no further SAF on float/slide (Cl. 57). Non-payment = rejection of seat. Cl. 58: once paid not refundable; however on valid withdrawal refunded after deducting JoSAA withdrawal processing charges of Rs. 7000; if seat cancelled for not meeting eligibility / unresolved document discrepancy, refunded after deducting processing charges of Rs. 5000. Pre-payment refunded in FULL if no seat is allotted. Payment window is printed as dates per round (allotment date to a 17:00 IST deadline), not as a number of hours.
